verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs and SDKs show the core capabilities (scrape, crawl, search, extract, map, webhooks, parse local files) are all exposed via API/SDKs and CLI, suggesting the API is the primary and comprehensive surface, with the dashboard likely just a thin wrapper — implying API-only usage is the norm rather than a subset of a richer UI. However there is no explicit evidence contrasting dashboard-only features (e.g. playground, usage analytics, team management) against API parity, so full equivalence can't be confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit UI feature inventory compared against API, confirmation that dashboard-only settings (team/API-key management, billing, monitoring UI) are all API-accessible, and independent corroboration of full parity.
